get_config: get the default hyperparameter configuration for nanodo transformer training
create_config_model: create a transformer model config with embed dim 512, 8 heads, 6 layers, and bfloat16 dtype
create_config_optimizer: create an adamw optimizer config with cosine decay, 100k steps, and 0.0016 peak learning rate
create_config_checkpoint: create a checkpointing config that saves every 2000 steps and keeps 100 checkpoints
create_config_eval: create an eval config that runs on the test split every 100 steps with max target length 512
